responsibility: Generates the build-time header gcn-device-macros.h from gcn-devices.def, translating per-device attribute records into preprocessor macros that the GCN driver/assembler specs use to form target-specific command-line fragments. It emits march-keyed expansions for XNACK, SRAM-ECC, wave64, CU mode, generic code-object selection, and a default ABI/code-object version policy, plus aggregate spec macros that dispatch on the selected processor and diagnose missing -march settings.
